# Expeditions

Fixes for the salvage expedition console.

- Opening an expedition console, or anchoring or unanchoring it, sends it a fresh state. Before this the console
  only refreshed when it spawned, when it changed parent, or when offers regenerated, so a ship whose console missed
  those could sit on an empty board with the timer at 00:00.
- If the station has no offers, none claimed, and its next offer time has passed, opening the console makes the
  offers on the spot.
